unitemized.reason: The Contract label and its plain filled check come from the template. The per-step rule that the contract must be stated is itemized under cp-015 so it isn't duplicated. 'Use names/signatures/paths exactly as given in the task description' needs the task text, which no selector exposes.

The ## Reproduction Script section is already compiled from the template skeleton. Whether the planned script really reproduces the issue before the fix and shows correct behavior after it takes judgment, and no kind can check that at planning time.
The template frontmatter keys (stage, name) and their values are already compiled from the template skeleton. The statement adds no rule beyond the skeleton.
The ## Plan, ## Reproduction Script and ## Requirement Coverage headings are already compiled from the template skeleton as section_present items.
The field prefixes (Target, Change, Contract, Verification, Path, Exercises) are already compiled as template labels. Per-step presence is covered by the cp-007/cp-008/cp-009/cp-013/cp-015 items.
